description: Commit the coherent v2 change set to the current branch feature/competitor-performance-v2 without staging any downloaded media. Stage only the new/modified source and committed output artifacts; leave all .scratch/ media and analysis artifacts untracked. Do NOT push and do NOT open a PR (the orchestrator does that into integration/vignette-v1). Depends on FEAT-002/003/004.
steps: Confirm the working branch is feature/competitor-performance-v2 (`git branch --show-current`).

Review `git status --porcelain` and stage ONLY these by explicit name: packages/captions/src/preview/vignette-full-page.ts; packages/captions/tools/render-full.ts; packages/captions/COMPETITOR_ANALYSIS.md; packages/captions/full-render-v2/zapp-vs-kira-competitor-performance-v2.mp4; packages/captions/full-render-v2/verification.json; packages/captions/full-render-v2/frame-teacher-exit.png; packages/captions/full-render-v2/frame-zapp-celebrate.png; packages/captions/full-render-v2/frame-button-press.png; packages/captions/full-render-v2/frame-coin-growth.png; packages/captions/full-render-v2/frame-impact.png; packages/captions/full-render-v2/frame-teacher-return.png; packages/captions/full-render-v2/frame-final-payoff.png; packages/captions/full-render-v2/comparison-sheet.jpg; plus any small helper analysis script added under scripts/ and the package.json/package-lock.json devDependency additions (ffmpeg-static/ffprobe-static) IF those were intended to be part of the repo (confirm they belong; if the beat sheet camera fields were edited in FEAT-003, include packages/director/fixtures/free-coins-classroom.beats.json). Do NOT use git add -A or git add .
Explicitly verify nothing under .scratch/ (competitor MP4s, raw voice MP3, decode artifacts) and nothing under node_modules/ or dist/ is staged before committing.

Create one or a few coherent commits (e.g. 'feat: vignette-scene S7 visual source for competitor-performance v2 render' and 'docs: competitor analysis + v2 comparison') with clear messages. Do NOT amend, do NOT use --no-verify, do NOT modify git config.
Confirm v1 (packages/captions/full-render/*) is not modified in the commit.
acceptance_criteria: All v2 source + committed output artifacts are committed on feature/competitor-performance-v2.
No .scratch/ media/artifacts, node_modules/, or dist/ files are staged or committed.
v1 packages/captions/full-render/ files are unchanged in the commit.
No push and no PR were performed by this feature.
verification: Run `git show --stat HEAD` (and prior commit if multiple) and confirm only the intended files are included and no .scratch/node_modules/dist paths appear.
Run `git status --porcelain` and confirm the tree is clean of intended changes and .scratch/ remains untracked.
Run `git log --oneline -3` and confirm the new commits sit on top of fb63d9a on feature/competitor-performance-v2.
findings: FEAT-001..004 were already committed (6bef0fc, 7d1cc77, 078c1b3, 66ef24a on top of fb63d9a). Remaining hygiene work: 4 untracked v2 render intermediates existed (packages/captions/full-render-v2/audio-report.json, caption-placements.json, mix.wav, probe.json). v1 (packages/captions/full-render/) never tracked these intermediates and has no explicit ignore for them (git check-ignore returned exit 1) - they simply were not committed. To mirror v1 and keep the tree coherent, appended 4 narrow path-scoped entries to .gitignore for exactly these v2 intermediates, with a comment noting the committed deliverables (mp4, verification.json, 7 PNGs, comparison-sheet.jpg) are intentionally NOT ignored. Verified: git check-ignore matches only the 4 intermediates and NOT the committed deliverables (exit 1 for deliverables). git status --porcelain clean after commit. git ls-files packages/captions/full-render-v2/ lists exactly the 10 committed deliverables (mp4 + verification.json + 7 frame PNGs + comparison-sheet.jpg) and none of the 4 intermediates. No .scratch/node_modules/dist tracked. v1 mp4 sha256 still 6317404e146e8b7fd9bef5e56760bdfa0f99c51e9de8da61ffb6ead1fa6afe28. node packages/captions/tools/verify-mvp.ts still exits 0 (status ok, gates 47/47). Did NOT delete the 4 intermediate files from disk. No push, no PR.
